001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.CgmStatusV2Response;
007
008import java.util.Set;
009import java.util.TreeSet;
010
011/**
012 * History log record Dexcom G6 CGM Data, opCode 256, size 26.
013 *
014 * <br>
015 *
016 * 
017 * <table border='1'>
018 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
019 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>256</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
020 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Dexcom G6 CGM Data"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
021 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_CGM_DATA_GXB"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
022 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByAndroid</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
023 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
024 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTconnectsync</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
025 * </table>
026 */
027@HistoryLogProps(
028    opCode = 256,
029    displayName = "Dexcom G6 CGM Data",
030    internalName = "LID_CGM_DATA_GXB",
031    usedByAndroid = true,
032    usedByTidepool = true, // LID_CGM_DATA_GXB
033    usedByTconnectsync = true
034)
035public class DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
036    
037    private int glucoseValueStatusRaw;
038    private GlucoseValueStatus glucoseValueStatus;
039    private int cgmDataTypeRaw;
040    private Set<CgmDataType> cgmDataTypes;
041    private int rate;
042    private int algorithmState;
043    private int rssi;
044    private int currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
045    private long timeStampSeconds;
046    private int egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
047    private Set<EgvInfo> egvInfo;
048    private int interval;
049    private int egvCount;
050    
051    public DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog() {}
052    
053    public DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval, int egvCount) {
054        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmState, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, timeStampSeconds, egvInfoBitmask, interval, egvCount);
055        parse(cargo);
056        
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Builds a record with {@code egvCount} = 1, the value a five-minute reading with no missed
061     * readings carries.
062     */
063    public DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatusRaw, int cgmDataTypeRaw, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
064        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatusRaw, cgmDataTypeRaw, rate, algorithmState, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, timeStampSeconds, egvInfoBitmask, interval, 1);
065    }
066
067    public int typeId() {
068        return 256;
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * <table border="1">
073     * <caption>Parsed fields for DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog:</caption>
074     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatusRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
075     * <tr><td><code>glucoseValueStatus</code></td><td><code>getGlucoseValueStatus()</code></td></tr>
076     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypeRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
077     * <tr><td><code>cgmDataTypes</code></td><td><code>getCgmDataTypes()</code></td></tr>
078     * <tr><td><code>rate</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
079     * <tr><td><code>algorithmState</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
080     * <tr><td><code>rssi</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
081     * <tr><td><code>currentGlucoseDisplayValue</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
082     * <tr><td><code>timeStampSeconds</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td><code>egvInfoBitmaskRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td><code>egvInfo</code></td><td><code>getEgvInfo()</code></td></tr>
085     * <tr><td><code>interval</code></td><td><code>raw[24]</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td><code>egvCount</code></td><td><code>raw[25] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
087     * </table>
088     */
089    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
090        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
091        this.cargo = raw;
092        parseBase(raw);
093        this.glucoseValueStatusRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
094        this.glucoseValueStatus = getGlucoseValueStatus();
095        this.cgmDataTypeRaw = raw[12];
096        this.cgmDataTypes = getCgmDataTypes();
097        this.rate = raw[13];
098        this.algorithmState = raw[14];
099        this.rssi = raw[15];
100        this.currentGlucoseDisplayValue = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
101        this.timeStampSeconds = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
102        this.egvInfoBitmaskRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
103        this.egvInfo = getEgvInfo();
104        this.interval = raw[24];
105        this.egvCount = raw[25] & 0xFF;
106        
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * Builds a record with {@code egvCount} = 1, the value a five-minute reading with no missed
111     * readings carries.
112     */
113    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatus, int cgmDataType, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval) {
114        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, glucoseValueStatus, cgmDataType, rate, algorithmState, rssi, currentGlucoseDisplayValue, timeStampSeconds, egvInfoBitmask, interval, 1);
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * <table border="1">
119     * <caption>Byte layout for DexcomG6CGMHistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
120     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
121     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
122     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
123     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
124     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
125     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
126     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
127     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
128     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
129     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatus) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
130     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatus) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
131     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>(byte) cgmDataType</code></td></tr>
132     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>(byte) rate</code></td></tr>
133     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>(byte) algorithmState</code></td></tr>
134     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>(byte) rssi</code></td></tr>
135     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
136     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
137     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
138     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
139     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
140     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toUint32(timeStampSeconds) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
141     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
142     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
143     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>(byte) interval</code></td></tr>
144     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>(byte) egvCount</code></td></tr>
145     * </table>
146     */
147    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int glucoseValueStatus, int cgmDataType, int rate, int algorithmState, int rssi, int currentGlucoseDisplayValue, long timeStampSeconds, int egvInfoBitmask, int interval, int egvCount) {
148        return Bytes.combine(
149            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(256, 0),
150            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
151            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
152            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(glucoseValueStatus), 
153            new byte[]{ (byte) cgmDataType }, 
154            new byte[]{ (byte) rate }, 
155            new byte[]{ (byte) algorithmState }, 
156            new byte[]{ (byte) rssi }, 
157            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(currentGlucoseDisplayValue), 
158            Bytes.toUint32(timeStampSeconds), 
159            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(egvInfoBitmask), 
160            new byte[]{ (byte) interval },
161            new byte[]{ (byte) egvCount });
162    }
163    
164    public int getGlucoseValueStatusRaw() {
165        return glucoseValueStatusRaw;
166    }
167
168    public enum GlucoseValueStatus {
169        PRECISE_VALUE(0),
170        SPECIAL_HIGH(1),
171        SPECIAL_LOW(2),
172        DO_NOT_SHOW(6)
173
174        ;
175        private int id;
176        GlucoseValueStatus(int id) {
177            this.id = id;
178        }
179
180        public static GlucoseValueStatus fromId(int id) {
181            for (GlucoseValueStatus r : values()) {
182                if (r.id == id) {
183                    return r;
184                }
185            }
186            return null;
187        }
188
189        public int getId() {
190            return id;
191        }
192    }
193
194    public GlucoseValueStatus getGlucoseValueStatus() {
195        return GlucoseValueStatus.fromId(glucoseValueStatusRaw);
196    }
197
198    public int getCgmDataTypeRaw() {
199        return cgmDataTypeRaw;
200    }
201
202    public enum CgmDataType {
203        FIVE_MINUTE_READING(1),
204        BACKFILL(2),
205        IMMEDIATE_MATCH_VALUE(4),
206        CALIBRATION(8),
207        NONE(16)
208
209        ;
210        private int id;
211        CgmDataType(int id) {
212            this.id = id;
213        }
214
215        public static Set<CgmDataType> fromId(int mask) {
216            Set<CgmDataType> items = new TreeSet<>();
217            for (CgmDataType i : values()) {
218                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
219                    items.add(i);
220                }
221            }
222
223            return items;
224        }
225
226        public int getId() {
227            return id;
228        }
229    }
230
231    public Set<CgmDataType> getCgmDataTypes() {
232        return CgmDataType.fromId(cgmDataTypeRaw);
233    }
234
235    /**
236     * Signed rate of change, in 0.1 mg/dL per minute.
237     */
238    public int getRate() {
239        return rate;
240    }
241    public int getAlgorithmState() {
242        return algorithmState;
243    }
244    /**
245     * Signed RSSI, in dBm.
246     */
247    public int getRssi() {
248        return rssi;
249    }
250    public int getCurrentGlucoseDisplayValue() {
251        return currentGlucoseDisplayValue;
252    }
253    public long getTimeStampSeconds() {
254        return timeStampSeconds;
255    }
256    public int getEgvInfoBitmaskRaw() {
257        return egvInfoBitmaskRaw;
258    }
259    /**
260     * @return the sensor type encoded in bits 11-13 of the EGV info bitmask per the Tandem schema
261     * (1 = Dexcom G6, 2 = Libre 2, 3 = Dexcom G7, 4 = Libre 3); see {@link DailyStatusHistoryLog.SensorType}
262     */
263    public int getSensorType() {
264        return (egvInfoBitmaskRaw >> 11) & 0x7;
265    }
266
267    public enum EgvInfo {
268        FIVE_MINUTE_READING(1),
269        BACKFILL(2),
270        IMMEDIATE_MATCH_VALUE(4),
271        CALIBRATION(8),
272        NO_EGV(16),
273        VALID_TIMESTAMP(32),
274        VALID_EGV_RANGE(64),
275        VALID_ALG_STATE(128),
276        EGV_PROCESSED(256)
277
278        ;
279        private int id;
280        EgvInfo(int id) {
281            this.id = id;
282        }
283
284        public static Set<EgvInfo> fromId(int mask) {
285            Set<EgvInfo> items = new TreeSet<>();
286            for (EgvInfo i : values()) {
287                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
288                    items.add(i);
289                }
290            }
291
292            return items;
293        }
294
295        public int getId() {
296            return id;
297        }
298    }
299
300    public Set<EgvInfo> getEgvInfo() {
301        return EgvInfo.fromId(egvInfoBitmaskRaw);
302    }
303
304    /**
305     * Bits 11-13 of {@code egvInfoBitmask}: the CGM sensor type. Tandem's FSL3 schema (opcode 480)
306     * names these bits "Sensor Type"; in captures they are 1 (G6) in 256 records from 2023 on, 3
307     * (G7) in 399 records, and 0 on 2022 firmware.
308     */
309    public CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType getEgvSensorType() {
310        return getEgvSensorType(egvInfoBitmaskRaw);
311    }
312
313    static CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType getEgvSensorType(int egvInfoBitmask) {
314        return CgmStatusV2Response.CgmSensorType.fromId((egvInfoBitmask >> 11) & 0x7);
315    }
316
317    public int getInterval() {
318        return interval;
319    }
320
321    /**
322     * Byte 25, which Tandem's schema leaves unnamed. It is 0 in backfill records. In a five-minute
323     * reading it is the number of readings the record covers: 1 normally, or N after N-1 missed
324     * readings, whose backfill records the pump logs right after it. The meaning is inferred from
325     * captures (see pumpX2#76); newer Mobi firmware has been seen writing 0 here for five-minute
326     * readings too.
327     */
328    public int getEgvCount() {
329        return egvCount;
330    }
331    
332}
